content: द्वितीय {%a.%} Second; त्वं जीवितं त्वमसि मे हृदयं द्वितीयम् <ls>U. 3. 26</ls>; <ls>Me. 85</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 49</ls>. .{@-यः@} .²1 the second in a family, a son. .²2 A companion, partner, friend (usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); प्रयतपरिग्रहद्वितीयः <ls>R. 1. 95</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 35</ls>; so छाया˚, दुःख˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 The second letter of a class. .²4 The second person (in <ab>gram.</ab>). .{@-या@} .²1 The second day of a lunar fortnight. ˚चन्द्र the young moon; द्वितीयाचन्द्र इवाधिकतरं शोभते प्रियवयस्यः <ls>Ratn. 4. 2/3</ls>. .²2 A wife, companion, partner; द्वितीयां मदभीष्टाय भार्यार्थे स्वीकरिष्यसि <ls>Ks. 98. 33</ls>. .²3 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The accusative case. .{@-यम्@} The half. .{@-यम्@} {%ind.%} A second time, again.
